design: One quiet wooded river itinerary with unequal reaches, close banks and retained original trainer landings. Fixed native rectangles/ports remain; old R05 is separated lookout/fishing coves rather than a visually continuous parallel river.

MnMississippiUpstreamWoods.purpose: Long lower run, one east-bank quiet pool, a narrow south-facing pine tongue, and the final landing at the northern woods keeper. This is not a copy of the lower river silhouette.

MnMississippiLowerWoods.purpose: St Paul leaves through a short angler approach, opens into a northern still reach, passes the existing southeast pine-bank trainer, then descends through a longer wooded southern course toward Winona.

r05_water_only_closures.purpose: Native forest closes only original Water cells between the lookout cove and southern fishing cove; all original land, bridges, piers, actors, gates and room mouths remain exact.
